On which days did WTI crude reach its highest spot prices?
SELECT period AS day, try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_barrel FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.RWTC.D' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many molecules in the blood–brain barrier set are known to cross into the brain?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_bbbp WHERE p_np = 1
Which NIH institutes gave out the most grant money in fiscal year 2023?
SELECT ic_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average weekly wage for private-sector workers in Brooklyn in the first quarter of 2024?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT avg_wkly_wage FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '36047' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1'
Which customs districts handled the most U.S. exports in 2024?

SELECT x.dist_name, sum(try_cast(d.all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_exports_district AS x ON x.dist_code = d.district WHERE d.year = '2024' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the fair market rent for a two-bedroom home in Albany County, New York?

SELECT areaname, county_town_name, try_cast(fmr2 AS double) AS two_bedroom FROM govblock_housing.hud_fmr_fmrs_sheet_excel_data WHERE state_alpha = 'NY' AND countyname = 'Albany County' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What kinds of insurance do Texans complain about most?
SELECT coverage_type, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_insurance_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much energy did New York State consume in 2023, in billion Btu?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.TETCB.NY.A' AND period = '2023'
What kinds of informal enforcement do regulators use most against water polluters?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were the combined year-end net assets reported on Schedule H?
SELECT sum(try_cast(net_assets_eoy_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_h
Which countries supplied the most smartphones to the United States in 2023?

SELECT c.cty_name, sum(try_cast(d.gen_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_imports_country AS c ON c.cty_code = d.cty_code WHERE d.commodity LIKE '851713%' AND d.year = '2023' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns were opened each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states had the most drunk-driving fatal crashes in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND try_cast(drunk_dr AS integer) > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What has a gallon of regular gasoline cost each June over the last ten years?
SELECT year, value AS dollars_per_gallon FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU000074714' AND period = 'M06' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10
Which utility territories have the most recorded solar installations?

SELECT utility_service_territory, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE utility_service_territory <> '-1' AND utility_service_territory IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How were full-service electricity customers split among co-ops, municipal and investor-owned utilities in 2020?

SELECT column07 AS ownership, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(customers_4 AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(customers_4 AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_energy.eia861_sales_ult_cust_sheet_states WHERE column00 = '2020' AND column03 = 'A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which medical specialties write the most Medicare prescriptions for insulin glargine?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_type, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE gnrc_name LIKE 'Insulin Glargine%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the WTI crude oil spot price on April 20, 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_barrel FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.RWTC.D' AND period = '20200420'
Which offices appeared on the most ballots in North Carolina in 2020?

SELECT office, count(DISTINCT precinct) AS precincts FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'NORTH CAROLINA' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many nurse practitioners are enrolled in Medicare in New York?
Medicare Fee For Service Public Provider Enrollment
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS nurse_practitioners FROM govblock_health.cms_medicare_fee_for_service_public_provider_enrollment WHERE provider_type_desc LIKE '%NURSE PRACTITIONER%' AND state_cd = 'NY'
Which states have the most school districts?

SELECT statename, count(*) AS districts FROM govblock_education.ccd_lea_029 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND sy_status_text IN ('Open', 'New', 'Added', 'Reopened', 'Changed Boundary/Agency') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many words do Florida's statutes run to in all?
SELECT sum(try_cast(word_count AS bigint)) AS words FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'fl' AND document_type = 'statute'
Which EPA divisions bring the most enforcement cases?
SELECT hq_division, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements WHERE hq_division IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademark registrations were cancelled during 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(reg_cancel_dt AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
Which companies hold ownership shares in the most generators?
SELECT owner_name, count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS generators FROM govblock_energy.eia860_owner_y_sheet_ownership GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average in-state tuition and fees at public colleges that mainly award bachelor's degrees?
SELECT avg(try_cast(tuitionfee_in AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE cast(control AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(preddeg AS varchar) = '3'
Which states produced the most wind power in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 14, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.GEN.WND-%-99.A' AND length(series_id) = 20 AND substr(series_id, 14, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of single audits filed change from 2017 to 2024?
SELECT audit_year AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year IN ('2017', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which federal assistance programs paid out the most in fiscal year 2023?

SELECT cfda_title, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_assistance WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many wrecks and underwater obstructions does the PR100 study map around Puerto Rico?
What was the average price of bananas per pound at the end of 2024?
SELECT value AS dollars_per_pound FROM govblock_labor.bls_ap_data WHERE series_id = 'APU0000711211' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
How many megawatt hours of wind did the Texas grid produce in 2023?

SELECT round(sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double)))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'ERCO' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
How many pedestrians were killed on American roads in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS pedestrians_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '5' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022'
What share of PubChem substances were taken from patents through PATENTSCOPE?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN c1 = 'PATENTSCOPE (WIPO)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_substance_sid_map
